# Bar5F Dispensing Pump Set for 1-Liter Shampoo and Conditioner Bottles

Turn your 33.8 oz bottles into easy-to-use dispensers with this two-pack of black bottle pumps. Made for 1-liter bottles with a 1-inch neck, they work with shampoo, conditioner, and gel.

## Built to Fit Large Bottles

Each pump measures 11.5 inches long and fits standard 1-liter (33.8 oz) bottles, including 1-liter Pureology bottles. You can keep using the products you already own without transferring them to smaller containers.

## Controlled, Mess-Free Dispensing

Each press releases a single, measured squirt. You use only the amount you need, so concentrated formulas last longer and your counter stays clean.

## Everyday Convenience

Press once, lather, and start your routine. The pump keeps large bottles easy to reach in the shower, and a second pump lets you keep a spare ready when a bottle runs low.

## Why Choose This Set

The black finish suits most bathrooms, and the two-pack gives you a backup for a fraction of the cost of replacing bottles. Its 4.5-star average rating reflects steady satisfaction from buyers.

Add the Bar5F two-pack to your cart today and make every wash easier.
